context.body: Cosmic warrior imagery and quiet trust occupy the same prayer.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The prophet portrays God coming in splendor and judgment, remembers mighty acts, trembles, and chooses joy even when fields fail.
observations.label: God’s terrifying advent becomes the ground of trust: action

observations.body: Fear and bodily weakness give way to waiting and rejoicing in the God of salvation.
observations.label: God’s terrifying advent becomes the ground of trust: response

observations.body: revive your work · wrath remember mercy · I trembled · yet I will rejoice
observations.label: Words in Habakkuk 3:1–19

payload.posture: Read Habakkuk 3:1–19 as future and faithfulness evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The poem’s imagery is poetic and historical memory; it does not map every image to one future event.
payload.title: God’s terrifying advent becomes the ground of trust
